ramadan-offer.prompt:
[SUBJECT] Vertical Ramadan promotional poster, warm lantern-lit evening scene with hanging fanous lanterns, dates and Arabic coffee cups on a carved wooden tray.
[TYPOGRAPHY] Bold headline in the upper third. Arabic typography reads «خصم 30% طوال رمضان» exactly as written: correctly shaped, connected Arabic letters, right-to-left, no Latin letters, no extra words. Smaller second line below it reads «على جميع منتجات القهوة», same Arabic typography rules. Business name «مقهى الحي» at the bottom in a smaller weight, same Arabic typography rules.
[STYLE] rich burgundy, gold and cream palette, high contrast between text and background, clean modern layout for Instagram stories, safe margins top and bottom.
[AVOID] warped or mirrored Arabic letters, pseudo-Arabic glyphs, English text, clutter, watermark.
